placements.why: Establishes the organizational system component handling intake processing, content derivation, and commit flows for memory submissions.
placements.title: Memory Submission and Ingestion Architecture
placements.frame: How does the ingestion pipeline structure data transformation and persistent storage for incoming submissions?

placements.title: Pipelines autonomously derive identifiers from content and ensure commit completion when explicit IDs are omitted
placements.frame: How do ingestion workflows guarantee file identification and storage when submissions lack explicit identifiers?
placements.why: src-1 and src-2 specify that submissions without explicit ID fields must be handled by generating slugs from content via LLM id-gen or deterministic fallback and successfully committed.
